exact_missing_items: Multi-account control-loop scope applies to ALL provider-using actors: assistant, interviewer, requirements-doc builder, overseers, node workers, delegated workers — no actor is exempt

Non-Orchestrator conversational actors (assistant, interviewer, requirements-doc builder, PRD builder) share provider/account/usage/runtime identity behavior but are conversational-first, NOT orchestration nodes
Overseer-spawned node worker is the NORMAL/DEFAULT execution path, not an edge case — documentation must reflect this as the primary worker model
Node personas must be auto-selected from node scope/type; persona override must be a global node-worker policy setting, NOT a per-node override
Plans/Personas.md must define overseer personas (Package Overseer, Seam Overseer) and their relation to lanes — current Personas.md only covers worker personas
Docker auth is the best existing example of a requested/effective auth pattern — this pattern should be extracted and generalized as the canonical requested/effective auth model

treat as three separate axes: source axis (where configured value came from), request axis (what the run/attempt actually asked for at execution start), execution/result axis (what provider/runtime actually used and whether controls were honored/skipped/clamped)
Canonical display groups for settings: Inherited from, Overridden by, Requested, Effective, Reason, Support
Source layers needing explicit labeling: app default, project override, surface default, role policy, seam/package/node mapping, manual override, turn/session/run/task/subagent scoped override
UI should show the winning source, not force the user to reconstruct precedence from docs
